payload.summary: ClaimTrack moves to Azure PaaS module by module: core and web upgraded in place (web strangled at the gateway), batch and reports upgraded and parallel-run, the broker portal rewritten in React and strangled route by route. Four frozen contracts and seven version traps carry the behaviour across.

layers.target: Azure App Service (Linux) · Container Apps Jobs

modules.rationale: Mechanical tier, score 24, fan-in 2: upgrade in place, dual-built while M-03 still needs Java 8.
LLM-assisted, Log4j 1.x and Spring4Shell flagged; /api/v1 is external so traffic is strangled at the gateway.
Java 7 EOL; financial output to the bank, so parallel-run with legacy sending until exit.
AngularJS 1.5 on Node 8 has no upgrade path; rewrite in React 18 and move route by route.
Python 2.7 EOL; read-only regulatory output, parallel-run over a month-end.

interop.routing: Application Gateway in front of Dallas at 100% legacy from W0; /api/v1 and portal routes move by weight.
interop.data: One database: online replication Dallas → Azure MySQL; the primary moves with the first writer (ADR-06).
interop.shared_libraries: claimtrack-core dual-built (Java 8 + 21) until the batch moves (ADR-02).
interop.jobs: Only one side's cron sends the bank file or reports on any day (parallel run, legacy sends).
interop.identity: Adjuster sessions stay on the web app; brokers authenticate at the gateway.

ordering_constraints: M-01 dual-built (Java 8 + Java 21) until M-03 cuts over (ADR-02)
Database primary moves with the first writer that moves (M-02) (ADR-06)
M-04 calls CT-01 at runtime: its cutover needs M-02 on the new side

frozen_contracts.name: PolicyHub nightly extract (read)
frozen_contracts.proof: same file accepted by both sides during the parallel run

data_migration.target: Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server 8.0 (US)
data_migration.method: online replication, then a switch inside a Sunday window
data_migration.cutover: read-only window, final sync, promote, switch connection strings (W2)

traps.change: MySQL 8 GROUP BY no longer sorts
host time zone Dallas CT → Azure UTC
javax→jakarta validation messages in API error bodies

adrs.title: Rewrite the portal in React 18 + TypeScript
adrs.context: AngularJS 1.5 on Node 8 is EOL with no upgrade path.
adrs.consequences: Longest wave; strangled route by route.

adrs.title: Dual-build claimtrack-core
adrs.context: The legacy batch cannot load a Java 21 build.
options: Dual-build core until the batch moves
adrs.consequences: Two artifacts from one source for W2–W3.

adrs.title: Strangle /api/v1 at the gateway
options: Weighted traffic shift at the gateway

adrs.title: Parallel-run the settlement batch
adrs.context: The bank file is financial output.
adrs.decision: Parallel run, legacy sends until exit

adrs.title: Keep adjuster JSP screens as a separate server-rendered app
adrs.context: The brief left this to architecture.
adrs.consequences: No new UI scope for adjusters.

adrs.title: Database primary moves with the first writer
options: Replicate, then promote with the first writer
adrs.consequences: Legacy writers re-pointed in the same window.

adrs.title: Pin the time zone to America/Chicago for batch and reports
options: Convert to UTC and change file dates

adrs.title: Container Apps Jobs for batch and reports
